# fopost_accounts (Data Source)

Lists the connected social accounts the API key can reach, with the connection health FoPost last recorded for each.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fopost_accounts" "acme" {
  workspace_id = "ws_01hzy8example"
}

# Anything that is not healthy needs reconnecting in the FoPost dashboard.
output "accounts_needing_attention" {
  value = [
    for account in data.fopost_accounts.acme.accounts :
    account.username if account.health_status != "healthy"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `workspace_id` (String) Narrow the list to one workspace. Omit it to list every account the API key can reach.

### Read-Only

- `accounts` (Attributes List) The connected accounts, in the order the API returned them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--accounts))

<a id="nestedatt--accounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `accounts`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether FoPost will publish to the account.
- `avatar` (String) URL of the account's avatar.
- `health_status` (String) Connection health: `healthy`, `degraded`, `expired`, `revoked`, or `unknown`.
- `id` (String) The account's identifier.
- `is_primary` (Boolean) Whether the account leads its platform in the workspace.
- `last_health_check` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the last health check.
- `name` (String) Display name on the platform.
- `platform` (String) The social network the account is on.
- `username` (String) Handle on the platform.
- `workspace_id` (String) Identifier of the workspace the account belongs to.
